text: ok next thing that goes with this is the glass/window material is not compiling through, they just come in as white walls like concrete
resolution: Glass/window pieces baked as opaque near-white boxes ('white walls like concrete') because the instance buffer carries color but no alpha — /test's glass opacity (0.3) / chainlink (0.45) was dropped. Fixed through the existing MATERIALS path: a base BuildMaterial with opacity<1 and no shader skin (glass/chainlink) interns a TRANSLUCENT FLAT material (empty wgsl + an opacity field added to the MATERIALS lump); the no-V8 loader renders those rows as individual see-through meshes (scene3d_color_a) through the existing transparent single-mesh pass, keeping the glass tint — shader materials still force white + sample their texture. MaterialAsset/Material gained opacity; ensureMaterials skips empty-wgsl (no shader to run). Verified: bake ships 5 materials, loader emits '237 translucent meshes' with no crash (the headless auto-shot frames the player away from the glass building, so visual confirm is the navigable run). The constructor.zig change in this commit also carried a parallel session's in-flight collider decode that the already-landed loader commit needed, unbreaking HEAD.
